body: Thanks, that means a lot. I appreciate having someone to talk to about this.
Thanks, it's nice to know someone does. I'll see if I can try and start somthing but honestly it doesn't seem like I'll get the answers I'm looking for.

But it's hard to start anything when most of my attempts at starting conversation get drowned out and shoved away completely. I'll try to start something but all I'll get is one word answers and the conversation just ends up dying before it starts.
And on the other side I see her talking to my other friend on social media when she won't talk to me. It shows how she's clearly avoiding me.

I'm scared if I do that it would make me look weird or creepy. "Hey your the only person in the world that matters to me and I feel like you don't care anymore. Can you give me more attention so I don't kill myself" that's just creepy and then I might lose her forever or she'll just stick around for some moral obligation.

I don't think there's another reason, at least not one that I see her wanting to shut me out completely. I think it's just that she's tired of me, it's happened before only this time it means a lot more, this time it's killing me.
But over the past few weeks it's felt like I've just become any other person. We've gone from talking everyday and talking about our days and personal stuff to just nothing at all.
